items.item_text: Registered in Radiation Therapy by the ARRT and licensed as a Radiation Therapist by the California Department of Public Health. Must obtain and show proof of License as a Radiation Therapist by the California Department of Public Health Radiologic Health Branch prior to start date if offer is extended
BLS certification through American Heart Association
High School diploma or equivalent required. Graduate of accredited school of radiation therapy
Two (2) years recent radiation therapy experience preferred
Experience using ARIA or IMPAC Varian and CT simulation equipment preferred
Radiation therapist assists with patient procedures involving patient simulation.
Varian Trilogy linear accelerator radiation therapy, and other radiation therapy equipment as needed.
Computer Interactions via ARIA electronic oncology information management system.

Greets patients, verifies patient identification, electronic chart for proper radiation treatment parameters and physician prescriptions. Provide patients, family and/or care givers information related to the treatment process; engages in discussion and answers questions regarding process, equipment used and explain the daily visit routine to ensure understanding of how their care will be delivered during the course of radiation therapy.

Prepares patient for treatment by assisting in dressing properly and directing/transporting patient to treatment room. Positions patient and equipment in accordance with treatment plan. Produces digital or film portal images and kV cone beam (CT-like) images when appropriate to ensure accurate patient position and treatment.
Programs equipment to deliver treatment as prescribed by physician. Works with dosimetrist and/or physicist as well as administration to assure correct electronic documentation of treatment.
Current knowledge of appropriate clinical practices radiation protection and quality assurance patient management and care charges basic dosimetry and equipment
